# Constrained Generation Library

> A structured-generation library built from scratch in Python that compiles a JSON Schema into a finite automaton and masks a model's tokens so the output is schema-valid by construction.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library

## Source

- [src/constrained_generation_library/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/__init__.py): Constrained Generation Library - schema-constrained decoding from scratch.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/cli.py): Command line interface for the constrained generation library.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/constrainer.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/constrainer.py): Token-level constraint masking and constrained decoding.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/data.py): A token vocabulary and deterministic fake models for demonstration.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/evaluation.py): Evaluation: validity rate with and without the constraint, and selectivity.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/constrained_generation_library/regex.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/regex.py): A small regular-expression engine: parse to an NFA, then run a lazy DFA.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/schema.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/schema.py): Compile a small JSON Schema into a regular expression for compact JSON.
- [src/constrained_generation_library/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/constrained-generation-library/blob/main/src/constrained_generation_library/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service for schema-constrained generation.
